steps: 零件库识别: 多槽带轮 (来自机械设计手册)
“A 型”  →  A 型轮槽 3 条（依据：GB/T 10412-2002（基准宽度制）/ GB/T 10413-2002（有效宽度制））
“槽数 3”  →  轮缘上开 3 条 V 形槽，基准线间距 e=15 mm（依据：槽间距 e 取自 GB/T 10412—2002 轮槽截面尺寸表）
基准直径 ⌀100  →  基准线所在圆柱面；外径 da = dd + 2·ha = ⌀105.5（依据：da = dd + 2·ha（ha 为槽顶高，标准表列值））
轮缘宽度 46.32  →  轮缘最小宽度 = (n-1)·e + 2f = 46.32（依据：f 为槽顶半宽，保证槽不开口在端面上）
内孔 ⌀25  →  中心通孔（依据：由输入给定；未给则按 dd 的 0.22 倍取）
轮毂/辐板  →  轮毂 ⌀48.75 × 45 长、辐板厚 9，轮缘内径 ⌀76.6（依据：手册带轮结构公式：d1=(1.8~2)d、L=(1.5~2)d、S≈(0.6~1)e、轮缘内径 d2=da−2(ha+hf+δ)）

build.semantics: Raw legacy Quick surface triangulation. Legacy parser adjusts undersized 30 mm rim width to its standard minimum. This input has self-intersecting groove-root intervals; STL is not a closed-solid/BREP claim.

section_curve_contract.coverage: Complete triangulated mesh intersection with the fixed radial/axial plane; includes inner bore, hub/web transitions, rim sides and all three V-groove flanks and roots.
section_curve_contract.sampling_note: Each intersecting triangle contributes a section segment; parity samples both endpoints, quarter points, and midpoint of each segment in both directions against the other section polyline.

surface_section_contract.derivation: Root radius is read from the actual Document.build STL vertex rings for the parser-produced pitch diameter and legacy A-groove hf; root intervals are paired from measured axial STL rings at that radius using std_pulley.spec root width. Probe coordinates lie on the legacy axial cross-section at theta=0; the Rust regression also measures point-to-triangle distance on both actual binary STL surfaces.
surface_section_contract.sampling_note: This fixed section contract is local evidence for the center bore and three groove roots, not a full analytic B-Rep or watertightness claim.

stl.format: binary STL, 80-byte header + uint32 count + 50-byte facets
